title: MIUI 11.0.2.0.QCNMIXM completely breaks xdrip
symptom: After updating to MIUI 11.0.2.0 on a Redmi 8, the user is unable to connect to the transmitter. It only connects about once an hour if restarting the collector and forgetting the transmitter.
evidence_quote: After downloading the newest MIUI version yesterday on my redmi 8, I am unable to connect to my transmitter, I have tried enabling and disabling every single option but have found no way to fix it, it only connects about once an hour if I keep restarting the collector and forgetting the transmitter.
